title: Authorized Amount of a Concern Line Carrying Supplemental Authorizations — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Authorization note — Service Accounts and Repair Orders.** For the estimate overage on an authorized concern line, the authorized amount follows the line's authorized estimate decisions:

| Authorized decisions recorded on the line | Latest authorized decision given | Authorized amount |
|---|---|---|
| Two or more | On or before the day the line's labor closed | The sum of every authorized decision on the line, because each later decision authorized additional work |
| Two or more | After the day the line's labor closed | The largest single authorized decision on the line |
| One | — | The estimate amount of the latest authorized decision |

The day the line's labor closed is the latest line date of the line's labor charges. Only decisions recorded as authorized count; a declined decision is not an authorized decision.

## Cases (hypothetical)
| Decisions on the line | Labor closed | Authorized amount |
|---|---|---|
| 420.00 on 3 June, 165.00 on 5 June | 6 June | 585.00 |
| 420.00 on 3 June, 165.00 on 6 June | 6 June | 585.00 (the latest falls on the closing day) |
| 420.00 on 3 June, 165.00 on 8 June | 6 June | 420.00 |
| 420.00 on 3 June only | 6 June | 420.00 |
